source: docs/L7V2_DESIGN.md sections 8, 10, 11 and 13 (approved 2026-10-30 as recommended: D-V5 two-level model, navigation features, (IP, UA, sid) keying, class-preserving probe gate; D-V8 every arm tuned on validation seeds to the same benign budget); docs/P3_DATASET_DESIGN.md sections 4.8 and 6
rule: The model side of L7 v2, frozen by commit before any L7 v2 or P3 capture (design section 13; the operating points themselves come later, from validation only). A change is a new file version, labelled post hoc in the design's 'As built' section; tests/test_l7v2_model_prereg.py pins every value, and each module's constants are tested against this file.

keying.sid_rule: sid_h = stable_hash32 of sid_set when the answer set a session (a session's first request), else of the request's sid cookie; with neither, sid_h = no_sid and the key is (IP, ua_h) as before
keying.note: design 8.3: the sid separates CGNAT users whose UAs collide; it is a key component only

ingest.hash: l7_ingest.stable_hash32; the raw URI, UA, Referer and cookies are dropped after hashing
ingest.ref_rule: the Referer's path and query (scheme and authority dropped) is hashed like the URI, so ref_h equals the uri_h of the page it names; absent: None
ingest.route_class: l7_webapp.route_class(method, uri), computed at ingest from the raw URI before it is dropped (design 8.2: class-level semantics may enter, identities may not)
ingest.idle_note: a key idle longer than this starts a new session: the engine evicts it, the trainer splits it at that start-time gap

request_level.nav_history: within the window, as uri_repeat: refetch, revisit and ref_known look at the window's earlier requests only
request_level.groups_note: design 8.2: the P5 default groups without server_timing (R17) and without size, as P5c's published variant no_size_no_server_timing; protocol stays off; plus nav
request_level.groups_label: re-registered 2026-10-31 under D-034 (the user's 'Approve all three', 2026-10-31T12:10:57Z), post hoc but before any capture (T038-03): the size group (log_rlen, log_bsent, size_ratio) is dropped; no view arm sees sizes, and with C3b aimed at export the response size would tell an export from a search for the request arm only
request_level.use: the per-request GRU, an offline ablation (design 8.1, 10)

views.order: request start time (msec - rt); ties in arrival order
views.open_rule: a page request (route class C1) opens a view; the key's following non-page requests belong to it until the next page request
views.pageless_rule: a request that arrives while the key has no open page view (before its first page in the window) is a pageless token of its own, so keys that never load a page (C2, API clients) are still scored
views.closed_rule: a token is complete when the key's next token starts; its dwell is the gap between the two starts; only complete tokens are scored, the open one never
views.history: within the window: the window's tokens are recomputed from its own requests, so revisit, refetch and ref_known look back over the window only
views.token_note: design 8.1's list: log dwell, request count and asset share, refetched-asset share, costly count, page revisit, referrer present and known, status and method mix, new-connection share; page_view marks a page view against a pageless token
views.summary_note: design 8.2: the HGB and the LR get the same tokens summarized, so a GRU win has to come from order

gru_shuffled.what: the fitted view GRU scoring windows whose tokens are shuffled within the window
gru_shuffled.operating_point: the view GRU's (theta, k), applied unchanged (design 10)
gru_shuffled.pin_first: a variant that keeps each window's first valid token in place and shuffles the others, at the same (theta, k) (T038-05: every C3b window starts with the key's entry token)
gru_shuffled.report: at the view GRU's (theta, k), the benign units each shuffled variant flags are reported beside every gap
gru_shuffled.label: pin_first and report re-registered 2026-10-31 under D-034, before any capture (T038-05)

models.training: Adam, BCE with logits; fixed epochs (each model's epochs), the last epoch's weights kept: no epoch or iteration count is chosen on validation (docs/P3_DATASET_DESIGN.md 6.1); one class weighting for every learned arm, balanced: the GRUs' pos_weight = negatives / positives of the training windows, the LR's and the HGB's class_weight 'balanced'; the HGB without early stopping (max_iter iterations); no architecture search
models.training_label: re-registered 2026-10-31 under D-034, before any capture (T038-04); before, the GRUs kept the epoch with the lowest loss on the validation windows, and the HGB had no class weight and sklearn's automatic early stopping on 10 % of its training windows

probes.uri_bijection_class: a random bijection of the window's URI identities onto new ones within each route class (every request keeps its route class); the same map renames the Referers, so the site graph, revisits and referrer consistency are kept
probes.sid_swap: a random bijection of the window's session ids onto new ones (absent stays absent)
probes.change: a change to a hard gate, approved with the design (D-V5, 2026-10-30): the L7 v2 gate uses uri_bijection_class where P5c used uri_bijection, which renames paths at random and so fails any model that reads a route class or the referrer's consistency by construction (F-V8); sid_swap is new. The P5c gate and probe stay reachable for reproducing P5c.

selection.data: validation captures only (docs/P3_DATASET_DESIGN.md 4.8); evaluation is scored by a separate step that refuses without the frozen selection
selection.budget_units: benign users: l7_dataset.user_units of the validation manifests (a pool counts by its users), pooled over the validation captures; allowed = floor(budget x units)
selection.unit_cost: a flagged key costs one unit of its entity; an entity's flagged units are min(its flagged keys, its units)
selection.objective: max attack-entity recall over the validation attack entities; an entity is caught when any of its keys is flagged
ties: lower median time to decision of the caught attack entities
selection.grid_order: k in k_grid order, then theta in theta_grid order; the first point wins an exact tie
selection.policy: p > theta in k consecutive scored windows of a key (design 9.1)
selection.policy_engine: at the view level the k consecutive windows are those the live engine would score: of the windows a key completes between two polls (polls at whole seconds of the log clock, poll_s apart; a window belongs to the first poll after its completion), only the newest engine.max_new_windows_per_key_per_poll are scored, the older ones are skipped and counted; the request level, an offline ablation that no engine runs, scores every window
selection.policy_engine_label: re-registered 2026-10-31 under D-034, before any capture (T038-06): before, the evaluator scored every window, so k consecutive could differ from the engine's on a key that completes more than 4 windows in one poll
selection.time_to_decision: from the entity's first request start to the completion (msec) of the request that closed the deciding window
selection.probe_gate: an arm that fails the v2 gate gets no operating point and cannot be selected

age_only.label: registered 2026-10-31 under D-034 (the user's 'Approve all three', 2026-10-31T12:10:57Z), before any capture (T038-01)
age_only.score: the key-level time since the key's first view: for a view window, the start of the request that completes it minus the start of its key session's first token; p = the share of the training benign windows whose age is greater (ties count one half), so a younger window scores higher and the theta grid reads quantiles of the benign training ages
age_only.windows: the view arms' windows (train_l7v2.view_windows), the same keys, sessions and denominators
age_only.operating_point: chosen on validation by the selection rules of every arm (budget, grids, ties, policy); no probe gate: it reads start times only; a diagnostic, never selected or run live
age_only.reading: near chance on validation: the AUC of p, attack windows against benign windows pooled over the validation captures, must lie within 0.5 +- auc_band; outside the band the validation captures carry key age, and every view-level result on them is labelled age-confounded: none supports V-A or 'sequence helps'. Its AUC per core family and its recall and benign units at its operating point are reported beside the arms

load_split.label: registered 2026-10-31 under D-034, before any capture (T038-02); descriptive, never a gate
load_split.data: validation captures only, every arm (and the age-only baseline) at its own operating point
load_split.phase_rule: a window is inside an attack phase when its completion, in seconds from the manifest's timeline.t0_wall, lies in [start_s, stop_s) of a phase of the manifest's timeline; otherwise outside (lead-in, tail)
load_split.benign: the share of benign windows with p > theta inside and outside the attack phases, with their counts
load_split.recall_by_load: attack-entity recall per load level: the intensity multiplier the plan records for the phase of the entity's schedule (C3b's is recorded and not applied)
load_split.why: the v2 probe gate is a pipeline-invariance check: server_load holds request starts fixed and view tokens read start times only, so it cannot fail a view arm, while closed-loop load reaches dwell, span and rate

engine.gates: flood suppression and the age gate of the P5 engine, unchanged; min_events becomes min_views
engine.event: l7_would_ban with the key (ip, ua_h, sid_h) and level view; no ban path (the enforcing arm is T-025c)
